newsitem.title: USA: Borders Group Q4 sales through Jan 5 up.
newsitem.headline: Borders Group Q4 sales through Jan 5 up.

text.p: Borders Group Inc said Thursday that sales for the fiscal fourth quarter-to-date through January 5 rose 13.8 percent to $617.7 million compared to $542.6 million the prior year.
Borders' total sales for the period were $282.2 million, a 39.1 percent increase over the prior year sales of $202.9 million, the company said.
On a comparable store basis, Borders said its sales increase was 11.3 percent.
Waldenbooks' total sales for the period were $331.3 million compared to prior year sales of $331.1 million, and on a comparable store basis sales rose 2.1, the company said.
For the year-to-date period ended January 5, 1997 total sales rose 14.0 percent to $1,849.4 million compared to $1,622.2 million for the comparable period in 1995, the company said.
Borders said its year-to-date sales increased by 43.7 percent to $898.0 million from $624.8 million.
On a comparable store basis, Borders said its sales increase was 9.9 percent.
Waldenbooks' year-to-date sales were $931.1 million compared to prior year sales of $965.5 million. On a comparable store basis, Waldenbooks' sales were flat, the company said.
